2dc4ea7a0e: Villars–Gryon–Les Diablerets links wide blue and red runs with views to Mont Blanc. The free ski bus stops 20 m from the building.
dd2dedd90d: The little rack railway climbs from Villars station, 500 m from the flat, straight up to Col de Bretaye at the heart of the ski area. Free with a valid ski pass.
